questions.question: 44, 96 and 184, when divided by a number x, leaves the same remainder in each case. The largest value of x is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

44, 96 and 184, when divided by a number x, leaves the same remainder in each case.

**Concept:**

The greatest number that would leave the same remainder in each case would be the HCF of the difference of the numbers.

**Calculation:**

Difference of the numbers = (184 - 96), (184 - 44), (96 - 44) = 88, 140, 52

Using factorial method, we find the factor of-

⇒ 88 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 11

⇒ 140 = 2 × 2 x 5 × 7 

⇒ 52 = 2 × 2 × 13 

We find that HCF of the numbers is 4 .

**∴ The largest number that divides 44, 96 and 184 and leaves same remainder in each case is 4.**

questions.question: In plants during the spring season, food material stored in the roots usually moves into the _______.

__
 
• Food like sucrose, is transported by the vascular tissue **phloem** from a source to a sink
 
• The food is stored in the leaf, and sink, the part that needs or stores the food.
 
• The source and sink for the food may be **reversed depending on the season**, or the plant's needs.
 
• **Sugar stored in roots becomes a source of food in the early spring when the buds of trees, act as a sink**.
 
• They need energy for the growth and development of the** photosynthetic** apparatus.

• This direction of flow of the xylem is always **unidirectional**, i.e., upwards.
 
• Hence, unlike the one-way flow of water in transpiration, **food in phloem sap can be transported **in any required direction so long as there is a source of **sugar and a sinkable** to use, store or remove the sugar.
 
• **Phloem sap** is mainly water and sucrose, but other sugars, hormones, and amino acids are also transported or translocated through the phloem.

questions.question: The colour of the clear sky is blue due to ______ of light by particles in the atmosphere of size ______ than the wavelength of visible light.

**Concept:**

 
• The mode is the value that is** repeatedly occurring in a given set**.

 We can also say that the value or number in a data set, which has a high frequency or appears more frequently, is called a** mode or modal value.**

**Formula used:**

**mode = l + ((f₁ - f₀)/(2f₁ - f₀ - f₂)) times h**

here, l = lower limit of modal class.

h = size of class interval.

f₁ = frequency of modal class.

f₀ = frequency of class preceding the modal class.

f₂ = frequency of class succeeding the modal class.
